applies_to: Current Universal Bank MVP/local-first plan; no retroactive v1.11 changes

decisions.question: Какими будут первые реальные данные в Bank?
decisions.user_answer_verbatim: секреты не  будут. всякие данные из публ доступа и мб какие то идеи. анализ данных.
decisions.interpretation: Publicly accessible source material, possibly own ideas and analysis; no secrets planned. This does not establish that ideas, annotations or analysis are public.
decisions.remaining: Implement applicable protection/exposure/retention/export controls before actual nonpublic data use; no blanket privacy acceptance.

decisions.question: Допустима ли обработка другими AI-сервисами помимо ChatGPT?
decisions.user_answer_verbatim: это возможно в теории,но пока не планирууется.
decisions.interpretation: Additional AI analysis/embedding providers remain a future possibility; no current integration or automatic data exposure planned. This does not remove ChatGPT-first strategy or independently allowed retrieval capabilities.
decisions.return_trigger: User requests an additional AI provider or a demonstrated capability gap requires considering one.

decisions.question: Нужен ли доступ к Bank, когда этот ПК выключен?
decisions.interpretation: Access while this PC is on is sufficient for current MVP. Always-online cloud hosting, replication and PC-off access are not required.
decisions.remaining: Existing local transport/backend runtime validation is still required.

follow_up.next_action: Complete minimal R0 operations/search/ownership/retention contracts; these three user questions are answered and must not be asked again. Future R5 clustering choice remains separate.
follow_up.remaining: No acceptance of R0/runtime/privacy controls from scope answers alone.
